oldskill.heading: Tidy up in Claude
oldskill.intro: {app} no longer uses a Claude skill. If you added the skill to Claude, delete it so Claude does not get confused. It takes a minute, and you only do it once.
oldskill.step_open: Open Claude and go to Customize -> Skills.
oldskill.no_claude: If you do not use Claude, or never added the skill, there is nothing to do.
